## Body

State at compact: #264 (F215+F216) merged 01b363e3, live-proven on the fleet daemon. #266 (F222 step 1, per-route request counters) is FINAL at dabbd040 after round 2, awaiting verdicts. Step 2 is not started. It owes the difficulties ledger row below, plus the fix the counters point to.

- Trust prompts (trust.rs). Read the WHOLE screen: Claude draws its prompt at the top of a tall pane, so a bottom-20-row capture is blank, and Copilot's menu scrolls in a short pane. Match whole unboxed rows below a heading row (Copilot's question, Claude's `Accessing workspace:`). Guidance AND keys come from the highlighted row, never the prompt's default. Round 1 was blocked (R264-001) for saying "press Enter, session only" while row 2 ("remember the folder") was highlighted. Claude's default is `No, exit`.
- pij_close E-NOID was not about cwd. The extension's MemoryRegistry is seeded once at boot, so any child registered later is invisible to it. It now posts /v1/close by id; the daemon holds the guard (self, recorded parent, or prime for a dead orphan; there is no PA branch, and pm-001 kept it that way). It kills data.kill_pane only when the daemon names the pane as the seat's own.
- Live-proving extension code: a seat's loaded extension is whatever existed when it started (check `extension_build` in `pij list --json`). A reload sent as a pij control, by the seat itself or a peer, is refused while the control context is unarmed: "Control context is unarmed; ask the human to run /pij". Proof route without a human: spawn a fresh OMP helper (`pij-rs spawn --harness omp --role worker --cwd <main checkout>`), message it to run the tools, then close it and kill its pane. LEDGER ROW OWED in the F222 step 2 PR (pm-001's ruling).
- Private-daemon proofs: pass scratch HOME, TMUX_TMPDIR, PIJ_RS_ADDR and PIJ_RS_STATE_DIR with `env X=… cmd`, never `export`: the session shell persists. A leaked scratch HOME broke git push and gh ("could not read Username"), and a TMUX_TMPDIR pointing at a deleted dir can fail tmux tests. `pij-tmux` `separate_adapters_cannot_both_reserve_one_pane` also fails on this machine on origin/main in a clean env, while CI passes it.
- Per-request counters (P266-001 blocker): build the key table once at router construction from Endpoint::ALL (every route is an Endpoint path), immutable, with inline atomics. No Mutex<map>, no per-request Arc clone, no first-request allocation, and a snapshot must never block recording. State that readings aren't transactional and counters wrap.
- F222 step 2 leads: whoami by pane already reads only that pane's rows (F182). But for a pane no live seat owns (Copilot's `unregistered (pane held)` status line renders every 10 s), the refusal path runs double_seat::stray_pane, which is the Claude census in the CPU samples. `refused` on POST /v1/whoami in ping's data.requests will size it. GET /v1/seats -> SqliteStatus::read decodes every row, tombstones included, then filters. Ask pm-001 before changing the status line's refreshInterval.
